stories.title: Narendra Modi became India's longest-serving continuously elected Prime Minister on 10 June 2026
stories.body: completing 4,399 days and surpassing Jawaharlal Nehru's elected-tenure record of 4,398 days (PIB).

one_liners: Narendra Modi became India's longest-serving continuously elected Prime Minister on 10 June 2026 — completing 4,399 days and surpassing Jawaharlal Nehru's elected-tenure record of 4,398 days (PIB).
